desc:
Ling Suyu used to be UH team’s marksman. To survive, he ran away wildly, baiting his teammates. In the end, his starter position was taken away, and he stayed as a substitute for four years.

They said that as long as he went up, they would lose, and he believed them.

Until one day, four years later, as his contract was nearing its end, he solo-matched with a support called Tang Yu’an.

Tang Yu’an: I’m here so don’t chicken out, go up and fight!

Tang Yu’an: I haven’t even died yet, and you’re running?

Tang Yu’an: Whoever wants to kill you can step over my corpse!

That day, Ling Suyu realized he no longer needed to run.

Also, the feeling of getting MVP consecutively was very good.

Afterwards, Ling Suyu contract with UH ended, and Tang Yu’an immediately invited him to his own Fight team.

In the end, UH could only regret.

This crazy marksman that dominated the battlefield and mercilessly crushed them, was this really that coward that seemed to run away at the first chance?

title: I'm Here, Don't Chicken Out
